findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed cloth hand towels in both the men and women’s restroom. Discussed with PIC that disposable hand towels are required and paper towels were then placed in each restroom. Ensure that disposable towels are available at each the bathroom’s handsink in order to wash hands properly. 

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Observed single service items stored on the floor in the storage closet. These items include but not limited to drinking cups and napkins. Discussed possible alternatives for storing the single service items. Ensure that single service items are stored in a manner that prevents them from contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. 

4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Unwrapped drinking straws were placed on the bar counter near customers. Discussed with PIC that drinking straws should be stored either behind the bar or should either be prewrapped if placed near customers. The straws were placed behind the counter by the PIC. Ensure that straws are stored in a manner that prevents them from contamination. 

4-904.11: (A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination. (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser.
